args: Authorize only the straight vertical descent to the supplied grasp pad height, still keeping the gripper open. Confirm open fingers align outside the two short-width opposing sides, with unobstructed side gaps and no bowl/stove/counter interference along the supplied own-finger envelope. Request named top_center as a valid depth point at the geometric center of the flat package top. If its depth is occluded, request the previously identified printed landmark as named p0 instead; do not sample the hand. On a retry use the other view, not the same occluded point.

geometry.aperture_assumption: Symmetric prismatic joint separation less one transverse pad-size allowance is a conservative screening model, not measured inner-face clearance; fresh visible straddling is also required.
geometry.p0_identity: White curled capital C beginning Cream near the upper end of the printed blue logo.
geometry.geometry_scope: Original same-frame upper boundary and planes, independently checked local top/support samples, and a new lower grasp target; actual pose margins must pass before closure.

result.explanation: Clear for the straight vertical descent only, keeping the gripper open. The visible fingers align outside the package's opposing width sides, with exposed counter in both side gaps. The package matches the earlier fixed-camera view. Using the supplied finger envelope and unchanged local geometry, the endpoint leaves approximately 5 mm above the counter and 8 mm lateral separation from the bowl; the stove is outside this sweep. The geometric top center is visible in the wrist view, not covered by the hand.

parameters.notes: Authorize only descent to pad height 0.918108 m at the current horizontal position and orientation, with fingers open. No closure, lateral motion, lift or transfer is authorized. Numerical margins use the supplied geometry, not new depth measurements. Current visible surface selections are returned for measurement. The stove is partly self-occluded by the robot; this is not an observed external obstruction. top_center selects the actual visible package top, so the p0 fallback is unnecessary. Package agreement is within image resolution.
